visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a bright indoor station food court. A male staff member wearing a black t-shirt, a black 'LORACORLO' cap, and a blue face mask stands behind a wooden counter, waving at the camera. Behind him is a large yellow menu board with text and food photos. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Close-up shot of a silver tray containing a vibrant Mediterranean meal: chopped salad with tomatoes and cucumbers, a mound of creamy hummus with a well of oil and a dusting of red paprika, and a pile of yellowish shawarma chicken over seasoned rice. A hand uses a wooden spoon to scoop the hummus. (3) Sequence of food preparation: Hands in white gloves spread thick hummus onto a sliced, toasted sesame bread loaf. Spicy tomato and eggplant topping is added with a metal spoon. Another shot shows chicken pieces sizzling on a flat-top metal grill, being moved by a spatula. (4) A large, braided sesame-seeded sandwich is placed on a newspaper-style liner. A knife slices through the center, revealing layers of fried chicken, sauce, and vegetables. Another shot shows a triangular sesame pastry being pulled apart to reveal a melting cheese and tomato interior. (5) In a small white cup, three green falafel balls are shown. One is split open to show the bright green, textured interior. The scene shifts to the storefront of 'LORACORLO express' within a station, showing yellow chairs, white tables, and a blue and white 'eye' logo on the wall. A customer is seen sitting in the background.
